chapter: Old New Orleans bands and Buddy Bolden
title: Mexican band at the 1885 Cotton Centennial
summary: Russell asks whether Tio's relatives were in the Mexican band at the 1885 exposition; Tio doubts it because family stories would have said so.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: and the famous Mexican band came up they published a lot of music they had the picture the band on there they're the ones that introduced over the waves and they must have published 20 or 30 maybe 40 different numbers from that that brass band played and is there any chance that your uncle or father or the other Marcus, uncle Marcus or anyone could have been in that band? No I don't think no

because at that time I don't think because... Would they have been here that early 1885 I think they were but I wouldn't know if they were in that outfit I don't believe they was in that outfit because had they been in that outfit I would be told
You would have heard about it because the picture is a well-known band
You see from generation to generation they always would relate us what they had their past life was
